Now I'm able to save $100 a month, its something but at this rate it'll be a few years before I'm able to resume. If by some chance you see this, miss my activities, and want to help accelerate this grueling process, I would be so thankful for your support
https://t.co/2f4alXzJAp

I originally thought I'd have plenty of time to work and handle this work, at least every now and again, but even the couple days I had for that have been eaten up. I quickly became the main reliable person at work apart from my boss and so now 2-3 jobs worth of work fall on me.

Brief personal update, I miss all of you so incredibly much. Basically right now I'm just working my butt off trying to save up enough money to try to do this work full time again someday. Its all I can think about, its all that drives me, so its just a matter of when and not if.
